maria: Thanks for joining the all-hands today. Dropping a short follow-up thread for any unanswered Qs, links, and owners. Recording: https://zoom.company/rec/mnopqr Slides: https://redwood-internal.company/all-hands/may-2026-slides

nate: Quick note: when we said "traffic shaping" in the performance segment, is that coming as a console control or API flag?

lee: Answer: initial launch will be API-first (runtime routing policy), then console toggle in the subsequent sprint. Will add a short doc link when available.

sam: Can we get clarity on the public roadmap blurb about model mix? Some customers asked whether curated models will be locked or swapped automatically.

emily: Is there an ETA for the model catalog UI we demoed? A PM asked for a cut of screenshots to include in partner collateral.

lee: Catalog UI target: internal beta 2026-06-01. Public screenshots after beta. Owner: @lee + Product.

kevin: I need the SLA bullets for a prospect call. Where do we point them?

devops-bot: SLA draft and bullets are in Confluence: https://confluence.company/contracts/sla-bullets (internal link).

maria: Action items: 1) @lee post API doc + console plan for traffic shaping by Wed. 2) @sam clarify external roadmap phrasing and share copy by Fri. 3) @emily collect model catalog screenshots for partners by next Tues. 4) @kevin publish 1-page SLA summary for sales by Fri.

nate: Also asked about dedicated migration checklist during Q&A  could we get a skeleton?

lee: Will add migration checklist skeleton to Confluence and tag Solutions Eng. ETA: next Thu.

maria: Thanks all. If anything else popped up during the Q&A, drop it here. I9ll archive once owners confirm links posted. :raised_hands:
